    // The world after solving row `index` once for velocity: restitution along the
    // normal, then Coulomb friction in the contact plane. Precondition: the row
    // names two DIFFERENT bodies, both in range.
    SolveRow(world: RigidWorld3D, index: Integer): RigidWorld3D
    {
        var row = world.Constraints[index];
        var a0 = world.Bodies[row.BodyA.Value];
        var b0 = world.Bodies[row.BodyB.Value];

        var n = row.Normal.Vector;
        var normalIncrement = ImpulseFor(
            row.TargetSeparationSpeed,
            SeparationSpeed(a0, b0, row.Point, n),
            DirectionalMass(a0, b0, row.Point, n));
        var normalTotal = (row.NormalImpulse.Amount + normalIncrement).Max(0.0);
        var normalApplied = normalTotal - row.NormalImpulse.Amount;
        var a1 = ApplyImpulse(a0, n * -normalApplied, row.Point);
        var b1 = ApplyImpulse(b0, n * normalApplied, row.Point);

        // Both friction axes are measured against the SAME post-normal state and
        // clamped together, so the cone bound applies to the friction impulse as a
        // vector rather than to each axis alone. Solving them one after the other
        // would make friction depend on which axis `Tangent` happened to pick.
        var t = row.Tangent.Vector;
        var u = row.Bitangent.Vector;
        var tangentRaw = row.TangentImpulse.Amount + ImpulseFor(
            0.0, SeparationSpeed(a1, b1, row.Point, t), DirectionalMass(a1, b1, row.Point, t));
        var bitangentRaw = row.BitangentImpulse.Amount + ImpulseFor(
            0.0, SeparationSpeed(a1, b1, row.Point, u), DirectionalMass(a1, b1, row.Point, u));
        var frictionMagnitude = (tangentRaw.Square + bitangentRaw.Square).Sqrt;
        var frictionLimit = row.Friction * normalTotal;
        var scale = frictionMagnitude > frictionLimit && frictionMagnitude > 0.0
            ? frictionLimit / frictionMagnitude
            : 1.0;
        var tangentTotal = tangentRaw * scale;
        var bitangentTotal = bitangentRaw * scale;
        var frictionApplied = t * (tangentTotal - row.TangentImpulse.Amount)
            + u * (bitangentTotal - row.BitangentImpulse.Amount);

        return RigidWorld3D(
            ReplacedAt(
                ReplacedAt(world.Bodies, row.BodyA.Value,
                    ApplyImpulse(a1, frictionApplied.Negative, row.Point)),
                row.BodyB.Value,
                ApplyImpulse(b1, frictionApplied, row.Point)),
            ReplacedAt(world.Constraints, index, WithImpulses(row,
                Impulse.FromAmount(normalTotal),
                Impulse.FromAmount(tangentTotal),
                Impulse.FromAmount(bitangentTotal))),
            world.Gravity,
            world.TimeStep,
            world.Solver);
    }
